investigation_notes.Description: An anomalous volume of SharePoint file downloads (250 vs 24-hour baseline of 30) was observed from the user originating from Tokyo. Lookup shows the user is a Principal Structural Architect in Architecture & Infrastructure and the sample files and paths are construction project documents consistent with that role; a prior similar alert (SOC-12550) confirmed the user is in Tokyo on planned travel. The activity occurred at 08:20 JST local time and the user agent and application are consistent with interactive SharePoint access, so the activity is assessed as Low Priority because it aligns with the user's role, confirmed location, and normal working hours.
